QUESTIONS.

Everything else you’re curious about.

What’s your flavor?+

Start with Midnight Lychee for something floral, Raspberry Rush for tart berry, Citrus Static for a sharp citrus edge, Mint Current for a cool finish, or Apricot Afterglow for mellow stone fruit.

How do I explore the collection?+

Drag or swipe the cans, choose a color on the selector, or use the left and right arrow keys while the collection is focused. Scroll to get closer to your selected flavor.

Can I buy VYRA?+

VYRA is an independent concept brand. This collection is a digital design experience; the drinks are not available for purchase.

What’s inside each can?+

The flavors and packaging are imagined for this concept. There is no manufactured formula, verified nutrition information, or caffeine specification.

Can I reduce the movement?+

Yes. Use the motion control at the bottom of the collection. The experience also follows your device’s reduced-motion setting.
